experiment: Repeated CV, training-only tuning, and latency verification

holdout.note: The held-out partition was reserved for one evaluation of each tuned best estimator. Repeated CV and grid search used only the training partition.

latency.method: Fit each fixed baseline on the training partition; 50 warm-up single-row predict calls; then five passes over the 653 test rows timed individually with time.perf_counter. Row slicing excluded. KNN/SVM pipeline scaler included.

unavailable_experiments.normalization_ablation: Not run: the available CSV stores only wrist-relative, max-absolute-scale-normalized features. Raw coordinates and the pre-scale wrist-relative vectors cannot be recovered by inversion. The extraction code accepts image dimensions for aspect correction, but those original per-sample dimensions are not in the CSV. No source images were processed.
unavailable_experiments.temporal_smoothing: Not run: no labeled video/ordered sequence artifact was found in the pre-execution read-only audit. The available landmark table contains feature columns and label only, with no sequence/frame order or timestamps suitable for sequence-level evaluation.
unavailable_experiments.signer_session_generalization: Not run: the available landmark table contains no signer or session identifier, and no valid group-held-out split can be formed.

preprocessing_mismatch: Not corrected or evaluated: training extraction operates on square still-image crops and passes image.shape; live inference passes full frame dimensions to x aspect correction. A non-square negotiated frame may differ from training feature scaling.
